content.text: The existing pipeline already projects quest-giver state into display tags and renders a yellow `!`. The quest definitions use `report`/`return` nodes as the “objective complete, return to this giver” state, while terminal `complete` is assigned only after turn-in. I’ll add a separate turn-in tag so a giver with a ready hand-in gets `?`, while ordinary available/active quest markers keep `!`.
